item.tib: dgyes mchod rgyas par 'bul ba'i tshig bshad ngo mtshar ud dpal la yi phring ba
item.coloph: bla med yang zab ma rgyud byams ma yi/ dgyes mchod so sor 'bul ba'i tshig bshad che/ ngo mtshar ud dpal la yi 'phreng (phreng) ba 'di/ bka' las 'byung bzhin nyi ming pa des bsgrigs/ 'di don ma rtogs 'gal ba mchis srid na/ mchog gsum lha dang mkha' 'gro bzod par gsol/ dge des rgyal ba'a'i tshogs rnams rab dgyes te/ mthar thug gtan bde 'bras bu myur thob shog/
